title: config responses
description: Standard output of config in JSON mode: showing (CONFIG-015), setting (CONFIG-130), resetting (CONFIG-202), --reload (CONFIG-022). Configuration errors go to standard error (config-error.schema.json).

fields.description: config [<key>]: the fields shown, all eight or the one named (ToolConfigResponse).

value.description: The setting as loaded (absolute for a path, the default when unset), null when it has neither.

done.description: config --reload (message: the build summary, CONFIG-022), config <key> <value> (message: Set <key> = <value>[; <build summary>], CONFIG-130) or config <key> --reset (message: Reset <key> (default: <default>) or Reset <key> (not set), CONFIG-202).

message.pattern: ^(Set [a-z-]+ = .*|Reset [a-z-]+ \((default: .+|not set)\)|Indexed [0-9]+ compatibles from [0-9]+ bindings and compiled binding schemas in .+)$
